scope: Critical application boundaries; not every helper function. Static AST inventory, no database contents. Source URLs are immutable audit-baseline anchors.

declared_fields.name: summary
declared_fields.declaration: models.TextField(help_text='Concise description of the case including age, stage and key features.')

declared_fields.name: risk_stratification
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=128, blank=True, help_text='e.g., High-risk cytogenetics, R-ISS II.')

declared_fields.name: lab_snapshot
declared_fields.declaration: models.JSONField(blank=True, default=dict, help_text='Dictionary of key laboratory values shown to the learner.')

declared_fields.name: guideline_notes
declared_fields.declaration: models.TextField(blank=True, help_text='Rationale, supporting evidence or pearls displayed after completion.')

declared_fields.name: expected_response
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=4, choices=IMWG_RESPONSE_CHOICES, blank=True, help_text='Target IMWG response. Optional; used for feedback.')

declared_fields.name: patient_age
declared_fields.declaration: models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Patient age in years. Range: 18-120')

declared_fields.name: ecog_performance_status
declared_fields.declaration: models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True, choices=ECOG_CHOICES, help_text='ECOG Performance Status (0-4)')

declared_fields.name: charlson_comorbidity_index
declared_fields.declaration: models.IntegerField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Charlson Comorbidity Index. Range: 0-10. Low: 0-1, Moderate: 2-3, High: ≥4')

declared_fields.name: patient_archetype
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=32, blank=True, default='', choices=ARCHETYPE_CHOICES, help_text='Patient archetype from virtual patient generator')

declared_fields.name: del17p
declared_fields.declaration: models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='TP53 deletion - high risk', verbose_name='del(17p)')

declared_fields.name: t_14_16
declared_fields.declaration: models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='Translocation (14;16) - very high risk', verbose_name='t(14;16)')

declared_fields.name: gain_1q21
declared_fields.declaration: models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='1q21 gain/amplification - proliferation advantage', verbose_name='1q21 gain')

declared_fields.name: hyperdiploid
declared_fields.declaration: models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='Hyperdiploid karyotype - standard risk', verbose_name='Hyperdiploid')

declared_fields.name: t_11_14
declared_fields.declaration: models.BooleanField(default=False, help_text='Translocation (11;14) - standard risk, better prognosis', verbose_name='t(11;14)')

declared_fields.name: tumor_cell_count
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Tumor cell count (cells). Range: 1e6-1e12. Typical newly diagnosed: 1e10')

declared_fields.name: tumor_growth_rate
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Tumor growth rate (per day). Range: 0.001-0.1. Typical: 0.01')

declared_fields.name: carrying_capacity
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Maximum tumor burden (cells). Range: 1e11-1e13. Default: 1e12')

declared_fields.name: creatinine_clearance
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Creatinine clearance (mL/min). Normal: >60, Moderate renal impairment: 30-60, Severe: <30')

declared_fields.name: beta2_microglobulin
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='β2-microglobulin (mg/L). Normal: <2, Elevated: 2-5.5, Very high: >5.5', verbose_name='β2-microglobulin')

declared_fields.name: ldh
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Lactate dehydrogenase (U/L). Normal: 140-280, Elevated: >280', verbose_name='LDH')

declared_fields.name: hemoglobin
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Hemoglobin (g/dL). Normal: M 13-17, F 12-15. Anemia: <10')

declared_fields.name: calcium
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Serum calcium (mg/dL). Normal: 8.5-10.2, Hypercalcemia: >10.5, Severe: >14')

declared_fields.name: riss_stage
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=16, blank=True, default='', choices=RISS_CHOICES, help_text='Revised International Staging System stage', verbose_name='R-ISS Stage')

declared_fields.name: difficulty_score
declared_fields.declaration: models.FloatField(null=True, blank=True, help_text='Calculated difficulty score (0-100). Auto-populated from difficulty scoring system.')

declared_fields.name: difficulty_level
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=16, blank=True, default='', choices=DIFFICULTY_CHOICES, help_text='Difficulty level category')

symbols.name: resolve
symbols.signature: resolve(drug_doses: Dict[str, float], time_horizon: float, fallback_pk: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] | None=None, fallback_pd: Dict[str, Dict[str, float]] | None=None)

declared_fields.name: owner
declared_fields.declaration: models.ForeignKey(settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, related_name='owned_patients', help_text='Primary owner of this patient record (minimal access control).')

declared_fields.name: flc_ratio
declared_fields.declaration: models.DecimalField('FLC Ratio', max_digits=6, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)

declared_fields.name: beta2m_mg_l
declared_fields.declaration: models.DecimalField('Beta-2 Microglobulin (mg/L)', max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True)

declared_fields.name: line
declared_fields.declaration: models.CharField(max_length=64, help_text='Line of therapy (e.g. frontline, salvage).')
